arxiv-1810-10535.title: Meta-modeling game for deriving theoretical-consistent, micro-structural-based traction-separation laws via deep reinforcement learning
arxiv-1810-10535.creator: Kun Wang, WaiChing Sun
arxiv-1810-10535.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Kun Wang, WaiChing Sun. This paper presents a new meta-modeling framework to employ deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to generate mechanical constitutive models for interfaces. The constitutive models are conceptualized as information flow in directed graphs. The process of writing constitutive models are simplified as a sequence of forming graph edges with the goal of maximizing the model score (a function of accuracy, robustness and forward prediction quality).

arxiv-2206-01838.title: Differentially Private Model Compression
arxiv-2206-01838.creator: Fatemehsadat Mireshghallah, Arturs Backurs, Huseyin A. Inan, Lukas Wutschitz, Janardhan Kulkarni
arxiv-2206-01838.description: Abstract Recent papers have shown that large pre-trained language models (LLMs) such as BERT, GPT-2 can be fine-tuned on private data to achieve performance comparable to non-private models for many downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks while simultaneously guaranteeing differential privacy.

arxiv-2206-11453.title: Optimal linear cyclic quantum heat engines cannot benefit from strong coupling
arxiv-2206-11453.creator: Junjie Liu, Kenneth A. Jung
arxiv-2206-11453.description: Abstract Uncovering whether strong system-bath coupling can be an advantageous operation resource for energy conversion can facilitate the development of efficient quantum heat engines (QHEs). Yet, a consensus on this ongoing debate is still lacking owing to challenges arising from treating strong couplings.

arxiv-2310-19448.title: Likelihood of white dwarf binaries to dominate the astrophysical gravitational wave background in the mHz band
arxiv-2310-19448.creator: Seppe Staelens ,, Gijs Nelemans
arxiv-2310-19448.description: Abstract Context. The astrophysical gravitational wave background (AGWB) is a collective signal of astrophysical gravitational wave sources dominated by compact binaries. One key science goal of current and future gravitational wave detectors is to obtain its measurement. Aims. We aim to determine the population of compact binaries dominating the AGWB in the mHz band.

arxiv-2401-04018.title: Almost commuting self-adjoint operators and measurements
arxiv-2401-04018.creator: Huaxin Lin
arxiv-2401-04018.description: Abstract We study the problem when an n n -tuple of self-adjoint operators in an infinite dimensional separable Hilbert space H H with small commutators is close to an n n -tuple of commuting self-adjoint operators on H . H. We give an affirmative answer to the problem when the synthetic-spectrum and the essential synthetic-spectrum are close.

arxiv-2406-12986.title: Simulating spin biology using a digital quantum computer: Prospects on a near-term quantum hardware emulator
arxiv-2406-12986.creator: Pedro H. Alvarez, Farhan T. Chowdhury, Luke D. Smith, Trevor J. Brokowski, Clarice D. Aiello, Daniel R. Kattnig, Marcos C. de Oliveira
arxiv-2406-12986.description: Abstract Understanding the intricate quantum spin dynamics of radical pair reactions is crucial for unraveling the underlying nature of chemical processes across diverse scientific domains. In this work, we leverage Trotterization to map coherent radical pair spin dynamics onto a digital gate-based quantum simulation.

arxiv-2408-00990.title: A Numerical Technique for Coupling the Momentum and the Continuity Equations for Semi-Implicit 3D Ocean Models
arxiv-2408-00990.creator: Ali Shahabi, Reza Ghiassi
arxiv-2408-00990.description: Abstract Semi-implicit methods are powerful and efficient tools for the three-dimensional modeling of coastal and oceanic processes. A semi-implicit finite difference method for 3D hydrostatic primitive equations is presented in this paper. The governing equations are time-discretized with an implicit treatment of barotropic pressure gradient and vertical viscosity.

arxiv-2506-19942.title: Predicting wide binaries and deviations from standard gravity using machine learning algorithms
arxiv-2506-19942.creator: Amoy Ashesh, Harsimran Kaur, Sandeep Aashish
arxiv-2506-19942.description: Abstract We present a machine learning (ML) framework for the detection of wide binary star systems and the identification of deviations from standard gravity using Gaia DR3 data. By training supervised ML models on established wide binary catalogues, we efficiently classify wide binaries and employ clustering and nearest neighbour search to pair candidate systems.

arxiv-2507-00530.title: Uncertainty principles associated with the linear canonical Dunkl transform
arxiv-2507-00530.creator: Umamaheswari S and Sandeep Kumar Verma
arxiv-2507-00530.description: Abstract . In this paper, we establish analogs of Miyachi, Cowling-Price, and Heisenberg-Pauli-Weyl uncertainty principles in the framework of the linear canonical Dunkl transform. We also obtain some weighted inequalities, such as Nash, Clarkson, Donoho-Stark, and Matolcsi-Szuc’s type inequalities. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 44A20, 81S07, 47A30 1.

arxiv-2510-00651.creator: RUAN BISPO 1,2,3 (Member, IEEE), TIM BROPHY 1,2,3 (Member, IEEE), REENU MOHANDAS 1,2,3, ANTHONY SCANLAN 1,2,3, CIARÁN EISING 1,2,3 (Senior Member, IEEE)

Multi-sensor fusion in autonomous vehicles is becoming more common to offer a more robust alternative for several perception tasks. This need arises from the unique contribution of each sensor in collecting data: camera-radar fusion offers a cost-effective solution by combining rich semantic information from cameras with accurate distance measurements from radar, without incurring excessive financial costs or overwhelming data processing requirements.

europmc-pmc1297593.creator: Kinloch A, Tatzer V, Wait R, Peston D, Lundberg K, Donatien P, Moyes D, Taylor PC, Venables PJ.
europmc-pmc1297593.description: Antibodies against citrullinated proteins are highly specific for rheumatoid arthritis (RA), but little is understood about their citrullinated target antigens. We have detected a candidate citrullinated protein by immunoblotting lysates of monocytic and granulocytic HL-60 cells

pmc-11547526.title: Palmitoleic Acid Inhibits Hepatotoxic Effects by Reducing Trimethylamine-N-Oxide (TMAO) Formation in High L-Carnitine-Treated Mice
pmc-11547526.creator: Qingzheng Han, Yu Liu, Xinyu Liu, Yue Geng, Qiu Wu, Hang Xiao
pmc-11547526.description: Background/Objectives: This study investigated the effects of palmitoleic acid (POA) consumption on liver function, intestinal microbiota, and trimethylamine-N-oxide (TMAO) levels in the serum of mice treated with 3% L-carnitine drinking water. The purpose was to highlight the impact of POA on liver injury associated with high L-carnitine intake. Methods: A correlation analysis was carried out.

pmc-11583755.title: Dietary contributions in the genetic variation of liver fibrosis: a genome-wide association study of fibrosis-4 index in the liver fibrosis development
pmc-11583755.creator: Poppy Diah Palupi, Chun-Yu Wei, Wan-Hsuan Chou, Min-Rou Lin, Yu-Jui Yvonne Wan, Wei-Chiao Chang
pmc-11583755.description: BackgroundThe fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index is a non-invasive method to assess the severity of liver fibrosis. The development of liver fibrosis is influenced by genetic predisposition and dietary factors. However, the modulating effect of dietary factors on the genetic susceptibility of liver fibrosis remains unclear.

pmc-11605738.title: Reassessing mirtazapine and akathisia: A case report on its efficacy in treating severe, treatment-resistant akathisia and a review of the evidence
pmc-11605738.creator: Madeline Chidiac, Bushra Elhusein, Niman Gajebasia
pmc-11605738.description: Antipsychotic-induced akathisia is a distressing movement disorder marked by intense internal restlessness and an urge to move. This report discusses a 44-year-old man with a diagnosis of schizophrenia who developed severe, treatment-resistant akathisia after taking haloperidol, a first-generation antipsychotic. Standard treatments for antipsychotic-induced akathisia, including benzodiazepines (Clonazepam) and benztropine, failed to alleviate the patient’s persistent symptoms, causing considerable distress.

pmc-11608504.title: Effects of Local and Systemic Metronidazole as Adjunctive Treatment in Chronic Periodontitis Patients
pmc-11608504.creator: Maryam Mehravani, Ehsan Houshyar, Sheida Jamalnia, Rasool Gharaaghaji
pmc-11608504.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to compare the effects of local and systemic metronidazole in patients with chronic periodontitis.Materials and MethodsIn this randomized clinical study, 30 patients (3 teeth per patient) were treated in three groups: scaling and root planing (SRP) treatment alone, metronidazole tablet as adjunctive treatment, and metronidazole gel as adjunctive treatment.

pmc-12446107.title: Whole blood count data and hematological parameters in US vegetarians: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12446107.creator: Maximilian Andreas Storz, Stefanie Kowarschik, Julian Herter, Roman Huber
pmc-12446107.description: PurposeLower white blood cell, neutrophil and lymphocyte counts have been reported in vegetarians. However, studies on this topic revealed conflicting results and most observations stem from small studies using convenience sampling techniques. Additional large studies investigating associations between vegetarian diets and whole blood count (WBC) data are thus warranted.

pmc-12528571.title: Electrochemical skin conductance is associated with peripheral tissue hypoperfusion in septic patients
pmc-12528571.creator: Jérémie Joffre, Tomas Urbina, Vincent Bonny, Louai Missri, Juliette Bernier, Lisa Raia, Jean-Luc Baudel, Eric Maury, Hafid Ait-Oufella
pmc-12528571.description: BackgroundAutonomic nervous system (ANS) dysfunction contributes to the pathophysiology of sepsis. However, studies using reliable methods for ANS activity monitoring and evaluating its association with outcomes in sepsis patients are scarce. The Sudoscan® device offers a non-invasive method to evaluate sympathetic function by measuring electrochemical skin conductance (ESC), but its clinical relevance in sepsis remains unclear.

pmc-12542207.title: Cold versus warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia in diffuse large B cell lymphoma: pathogenic and therapeutic implications: a case series
pmc-12542207.creator: Zhiye Zhang, Xingxing Yu, Jingjing Li, Tianwen Gao
pmc-12542207.description: BackgroundAutoimmune hemolytic anemia-associated diffuse large B cell lymphoma is rare, with distinct pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic responses in cold agglutinin syndrome (CAS) and warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia subtypes poorly characterized. This report highlights two novel cases demonstrating subtype-specific molecular drivers and treatment outcomes, underscoring the necessity for precision management.

pmc-12609719.title: Lipidomic Signature of Patients with Familial Hypercholesterolemia Carrying Pathogenic Variants Unveils a Cue of Increased Cardiovascular Risk
pmc-12609719.creator: Giulia De Simone, Maria Donata Di Taranto, Debora Paris, Martina Ferrandino, Marco Andolfi, Annalaura Iodice, Giovanna Cardiero, Carmine De Luca, Luigi Junior Valletta, Ilenia Lorenza Calcaterra, Gabriella Iannuzzo, Matteo Nicola Dario Di Minno, Giuliana Fortunato, Adele Cutignano
pmc-12609719.description: Familial Hypercholesterolemia (FH) is a common genetic disorder characterized by elevated LDL-cholesterol levels and an increased risk of premature cardiovascular disease. While pathogenic variants in LDLR, APOB, and PCSK9 are well-established causes, a substantial proportion of clinically suspected FH cases do not carry either pathogenic variants or rare variants of uncertain significance in these genes (FH/V−/USV−).

pmc-13157796.title: Advancing sustainable medication use in healthcare: a Delphi study on (de)prescribing interventions
pmc-13157796.creator: Elisabeth Marissa Smale, Jiske Lianne van der Giessen, Cathelijne Willemijne Yvonne Appels, Emiel Leegwater, Marlieke Dietz, Patricia Maria Lucia Adriana van den Bemt, Saskia Coenradie, Rudolf Bertijn Kool, Henk-Frans Kwint, Erwin Ista, Nicole Hunfeld
pmc-13157796.description: ObjectiveTo identify and prioritise the most appropriate (de)prescribing interventions in inpatient and outpatient hospital care to advance environmentally sustainable healthcare.DesignA modified RAND Delphi study.SettingInpatient and outpatient hospital care in the Netherlands.ParticipantsThe Delphi panel consisted of 63 participants, comprising 36 physicians and 27 pharmacists working in Dutch hospitals.

pmc-13174571.title: Seeing Anxiety: Ecological Video Ethnography and Simulation to Understand Anxiety and Decision‐Making in Dental Care
pmc-13174571.creator: Mona Nasser, Hannah Drayson, Sally Hanks, Nicholas Peres, Michael Punt
pmc-13174571.description: BackgroundDental anxiety is a widespread barrier to care, often contributing to appointment avoidance, treatment disruption, and emotional strain for both patients and clinicians. While extensively studied as a psychological trait, less attention has been paid to how anxiety manifests situationally and relationally, through non‐verbal, affective, and spatial cues within clinical encounters.

pmc-13599202.title: Dysregulation of the miR-4286 in diabetic kidney disease and its role in inflammatory response
pmc-13599202.creator: Jiayong Zhang, Qilin Tang, Mengmeng Pu, Lin Yan, Yijun Chen, Bin Wang
pmc-13599202.description: ObjectiveWe aimed to investigate the expression level and diagnostic value of miR-4286 in serum of DKD patients and validate its effect on podocyte inflammatory response and apoptosis in vitro.MethodsWe detected the expression level of serum miR-4286 and CADM1 in DKD patients and healthy individuals.

pmc-13626876.title: Gastrointestinal mucormycosis with no classical immunosuppression and the potential for Qat leaves chewing as an unidentified risk factor: a case report
pmc-13626876.creator: Fahad S. Alanazi, Hamad A. Alyami, Saeed R. Alzubide, Oweida F. Aldosary, Saleh Y. Alomar, Ali S. F. Owayed, Yahya A. Mohzari, Ahmad Alamer
pmc-13626876.description: Gastrointestinal mucormycosis is a rare, life-threatening invasive fungal infection that is often diagnosed late because of nonspecific clinical and endoscopic findings. Khat or Qat (Catha edulis) leaves may harbor environmental fungi, including Mucor species, and chronic chewing may contribute to gastrointestinal mucosal injury. However, a possible association between Qat use and gastrointestinal mucormycosis has not been established.
